notify.no_orb: Place an NCS Visualizer widget on the desktop first (desktop widget editor).

audio_source.description: PipeWire/PulseAudio source for CAVA. Empty uses the default output (what you hear)
audio_source.label: Audio source

color_source.description: Follow the Noctalia theme (changes with your wallpaper) or pick a fixed colour
color_source.label: Colour

dot_density.description: Dots per side of the grid. Original is 322 (103,684 dots); lower is lighter on the GPU
dot_density.label: Dot density

fps.description: Higher is smoother but costs more GPU
fps.label: Frame rate

glow_mode.description: Colour of the soft glow around the dots
glow_mode.label: Glow

hide_when_idle.description: Fade the orb out while nothing is playing
hide_when_idle.label: Hide when silent

idle_seconds.description: Seconds without sound before the orb stops moving (and hides, if enabled)
idle_seconds.label: Silence timeout (s)

layer.description: Behind windows like other desktop widgets, or always on top of them
layer.label: Layer

motion_model.description: Original matches spicetify-visualizer exactly; Aurora adds a spring and punches on each beat
motion_model.label: Motion

noise_reduction.description: CAVA noise reduction, 0-100. Higher is smoother but slower to react
noise_reduction.label: Smoothing

orb_scale.description: Size of the orb inside the widget box
orb_scale.label: Orb size

punch.description: How hard the orb pops on each beat
punch.label: Beat punch

renderer_path.description: Path to the aurora-ncs binary. Empty searches PATH and ~/.local/bin
renderer_path.label: Renderer path

sensitivity.description: How strongly the orb reacts to the audio level
sensitivity.label: Sensitivity

widget.crashed_hint: Run aurora-ncs --config {path} in a terminal to see why.
widget.disabled_hint: Turn it on from the Control Center tile.
widget.missing_cava_hint: Install the cava package to capture audio.
widget.missing_renderer_hint: Install aurora-ncs - see the plugin page for the one-line build.
